documents.text: Mari Biya, became the first Babur king to rule from Biu. The name of Biu was initially called Viu which in Babur and Bura Language means high.?The emir's palace is now situated in the town. With British rule, Biu division was created in 1918. Mai Ari Dogo was acknowledged as the first emir of Biu in 1920. The area became known as the Biu federation after 1957, when the districts of Shani and Askira were added to the emirate.
